description: Metformin is the most commonly prescribed medication for type 2 diabetes. It lowers the amount of sugar your liver releases into your blood and helps your body respond better to insulin.
howItWorks: Metformin works in three ways: it reduces the amount of glucose produced by your liver, it slows the absorption of sugar from your intestines, and it helps your muscle cells use insulin more effectively. It does not cause your body to produce more insulin, which is why it rarely causes dangerously low blood sugar on its own.

commonSideEffects.advice: Take with food. Symptoms usually improve as your body adjusts.

commonSideEffects.frequency: Common when starting or increasing dose
commonSideEffects.advice: Start with a low dose and increase gradually. Drink plenty of water.
This is harmless and usually goes away on its own.
Eat regular small meals even if you do not feel hungry.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Lactic acidosis (very rare): unusual muscle pain, difficulty breathing, stomach pain, feeling cold, dizziness
seriousSideEffects.action: Stop taking metformin and go to the hospital immediately. This is rare but serious.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Severe allergic reaction: rash, swelling, difficulty breathing

avoidanceWarnings.reason: Drinking alcohol while taking metformin increases the risk of lactic acidosis and can cause dangerously low blood sugar.
Bitter gourd can lower blood sugar on its own. Combining it with metformin may cause blood sugar to drop too low.

whenToSeekHelp: Contact your doctor if you experience persistent vomiting, severe stomach pain, unusual tiredness, or muscle cramps. If you feel extremely cold, dizzy, or have difficulty breathing, go to the emergency room immediately.
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature between 15-25 degrees Celsius. Keep in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Protect from moisture and light. Do not store in the bathroom.

description: Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker used to treat high blood pressure. It relaxes your blood vessels so blood can flow more easily, reducing the strain on your heart.
howItWorks: Amlodipine blocks calcium from entering the muscle cells of your heart and blood vessels. When calcium is blocked, the blood vessels relax and widen, allowing blood to flow through more easily. This lowers your blood pressure and reduces the workload on your heart. The effect builds up over 7-10 days.

commonSideEffects.advice: Elevate your feet when sitting. This is not dangerous but tell your doctor if it bothers you.
Usually improves as your body adjusts. Take a mild painkiller if needed.
This is caused by blood vessels widening. It is not harmful.

commonSideEffects.frequency: Occasional, especially when standing up quickly
commonSideEffects.advice: Stand up slowly from sitting or lying down. Avoid driving if you feel dizzy.

seriousSideEffects.action: Lie down and call your doctor. If it happens repeatedly, go to the hospital.

avoidanceWarnings.reason: Grapefruit can increase the amount of amlodipine in your blood, making side effects worse.
This herbal supplement can reduce the effectiveness of amlodipine, causing your blood pressure to rise.

whenToSeekHelp: Contact your doctor if you notice significant ankle swelling that does not improve, persistent headaches, or if your blood pressure readings remain high despite taking amlodipine regularly.
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature between 15-30 degrees Celsius. Keep away from moisture. Store in the original blister pack until ready to take. Do not refrigerate.

description: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that treats high blood pressure. It blocks a chemical in your body that causes blood vessels to tighten, helping them relax and lowering blood pressure.
howItWorks: Losartan blocks the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that normally causes blood vessels to narrow. By blocking this hormone at its receptor, losartan allows blood vessels to relax and widen. It also reduces the amount of water and salt your kidneys retain, further lowering blood pressure. It provides kidney-protective benefits for people with diabetes.

commonSideEffects.advice: Stand up slowly. Avoid driving until you know how losartan affects you.
Mild cold-like symptoms may occur. See your doctor if they persist.
Stay hydrated and stretch regularly. Tell your doctor if pain is severe.

commonSideEffects.frequency: Common in the first few weeks
commonSideEffects.advice: This usually improves as your body adjusts to the medication.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Signs of high potassium: muscle weakness, slow heartbeat, tingling
seriousSideEffects.action: Contact your doctor immediately. High potassium can be dangerous.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Signs of kidney problems: changes in urination amount, swelling in feet or ankles
seriousSideEffects.action: See your doctor as soon as possible for blood tests.

avoidanceWarnings.reason: Losartan can raise potassium levels. Adding more potassium can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems.
Regular use of these painkillers can reduce the blood pressure lowering effect of losartan and harm your kidneys.

whenToSeekHelp: Contact your doctor if you experience swelling of your face, lips, or tongue, difficulty breathing, or if you notice a significant decrease in the amount of urine you pass.
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature between 15-30 degrees Celsius. Keep in the original container, tightly closed. Protect from light. Do not store in humid environments like the bathroom.

description: Atorvastatin is a statin medication used to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke. It is one of the most widely prescribed medications for people with diabetes or hypertension who have elevated cholesterol.
howItWorks: Atorvastatin works by blocking an enzyme in your liver called HMG-CoA reductase, which your body uses to make cholesterol. By reducing cholesterol production, atorvastatin lowers the levels of LDL (bad) cholesterol and triglycerides in your blood while slightly raising HDL (good) cholesterol. It also helps stabilise existing fatty deposits in your blood vessels, reducing the risk of them breaking off and causing a heart attack or stroke.

commonSideEffects.advice: Mild muscle aches are usually harmless. Stay active and stretch regularly. Tell your doctor if pain is persistent or severe.

commonSideEffects.frequency: Common in the first few weeks
commonSideEffects.advice: Usually improves as your body adjusts. A mild painkiller can help.
Take with food if stomach upset occurs. Symptoms usually settle within a few days.
Try taking atorvastatin in the morning instead of at night if this occurs.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Severe unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness, especially with fever or dark urine (rhabdomyolysis)
seriousSideEffects.action: Stop taking atorvastatin and seek emergency medical attention immediately. This is rare but can cause kidney damage.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Signs of liver problems: yellowing of skin or eyes, dark urine, persistent nausea, upper stomach pain
seriousSideEffects.action: Contact your doctor immediately. Liver function tests may be needed.

avoidanceWarnings.reason: Grapefruit inhibits the enzyme that breaks down atorvastatin, increasing drug levels in your blood and raising the risk of side effects including muscle damage.
This herbal supplement speeds up the breakdown of atorvastatin in your liver, potentially making it ineffective at controlling your cholesterol.
Heavy alcohol use combined with atorvastatin increases the risk of liver damage. Limit alcohol to occasional small amounts.

whenToSeekHelp: Contact your doctor urgently if you experience unexplained muscle pain or weakness, especially if accompanied by fever, dark-coloured urine, or general tiredness. Also seek help if you notice yellowing of your skin or eyes.
storageInstructions: Store at room temperature between 15-25 degrees Celsius. Keep in the original packaging to protect from moisture. Do not store above 30 degrees Celsius. Keep out of direct sunlight.

description: Metformin ni dawa inayotumiwa sana kwa ugonjwa wa kisukari aina ya 2. Inapunguza kiasi cha sukari ambacho ini yako inazalisha na kusaidia mwili wako kutumia insulini vizuri zaidi.
howItWorks: Metformin inafanya kazi kwa njia tatu: inapunguza kiasi cha sukari inayozalishwa na ini yako, inapunguza kasi ya kunyonya sukari kutoka kwenye utumbo wako, na inasaidia seli za misuli yako kutumia insulini vizuri zaidi. Haifanyi mwili wako kuzalisha insulini zaidi, ndiyo sababu mara chache husababisha sukari ya damu kushuka sana peke yake.

commonSideEffects.advice: Tumia dawa pamoja na chakula. Dalili hizi huisha mwili unapoizoea.

commonSideEffects.frequency: Kawaida wakati wa kuanza au kuongeza dozi
commonSideEffects.advice: Anza na dozi ndogo na uongeze taratibu. Kunywa maji mengi.
Hii si hatari na huisha yenyewe.
Kula milo midogo mara kwa mara hata kama huna hamu ya kula.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Lactic acidosis (nadra sana): maumivu ya misuli yasiyo ya kawaida, ugumu wa kupumua, maumivu ya tumbo, kuhisi baridi, kizunguzungu
seriousSideEffects.action: Acha kutumia metformin na nenda hospitali mara moja. Hii ni nadra lakini ni hatari.

seriousSideEffects.effect: Mzio mkubwa: upele, kuvimba, ugumu wa kupumua
seriousSideEffects.action: Tafuta msaada wa dharura wa matibabu mara moja.

avoidanceWarnings.reason: Kunywa pombe wakati unatumia metformin kunaongeza hatari ya lactic acidosis na kunaweza kusababisha sukari ya damu kushuka sana.
Mkarela inaweza kupunguza sukari ya damu yenyewe. Kuchanganya na metformin kunaweza kusababisha sukari ya damu kushuka sana.

whenToSeekHelp: Wasiliana na daktari wako ukipata kutapika kwa muda mrefu, maumivu makubwa ya tumbo, uchovu usio wa kawaida, au misuli kukakamaa. Ukihisi baridi sana, kizunguzungu, au ugumu wa kupumua, nenda chumba cha dharura mara moja.
storageInstructions: Hifadhi kwa joto la kawaida kati ya nyuzi joto 15-25. Weka kwenye chombo cha asili na kifuniko kimefungwa vizuri. Linda kutokana na unyevu na mwanga. Usihifadhi bafuni.
